scope: Local source; CRM enabled; no network, model or database acceptance
limitations: Schema failures can precede authorization failures
Gate replay uses a sentinel, not real database writes
No successful workflow or agent-injection score implied

inventory.name: verify_synthetic_identity
inventory.title: Verify Synthetic Veteran Identity
inventory.description:
Match a caller's stated full name and DOB against synthetic fixtures.

For the inbound intake case, a verified match returns the target synthetic
scheduling case ID, without revealing names, DOB, ICNs, phone or address.
Use ``verified`` for the match result; ``patient_match_enabled`` is
separate fixture metadata and does not prohibit an identity match. A
missing match means the caller must not access that patient's scheduling
data.

case_id.description: Approved case ID or DEMO-PC-VOICE-INTAKE-001 for incoming calls.

full_name.description: Veteran-stated full name for synthetic verification.

birth_date.description: Veteran-stated date of birth; common spoken or typed formats are accepted.

inventory.name: determine_workflow_state
inventory.title: Determine Workflow State
inventory.description: Return the deterministic scheduling workflow state for a synthetic case.

inventory.name: search_availability
inventory.title: Search Scheduling Availability
inventory.description: Search all synthetic sources after deterministic workflow gating.

inventory.name: assess_access_standard
inventory.title: Assess VA Access Standard
inventory.description:
Assess internal VA wait time from canonical PID.

This tool never grants Community Care authorization.

inventory.name: check_community_care_eligibility
inventory.title: Check Community Care Eligibility Evidence
inventory.description:
Provide access-standard context without claiming VA eligibility.

This synthetic-only status check is not a VA eligibility API call.
Eligibility remains UNVERIFIED and cannot authorize an appointment.

inventory.name: get_case_lifecycle_state
inventory.title: Get Case Lifecycle State
inventory.description:
Return the current lifecycle state for a synthetic scheduling case.

Read-only. Returns:
- current_state: the most recent lifecycle state
- last_event_type: the event that produced the current state
- last_event_at: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last event
- event_count: total number of lifecycle events recorded
- event_history (if include_history=true): full ordered event list

Returns found=false with an error message if the case_id is unknown.
Does not mutate lifecycle state. Does not expose PHI.

include_history.description: When true, include the full ordered event history in the response. Default false — returns current state summary only.

inventory.name: get_scheduling_encounter
inventory.title: Get Governed Scheduling Encounter
inventory.description:
Assemble request, classification, capacity, access standard, preferences,
and current governed lifecycle state in one read-only encounter.

inventory.name: prepare_scheduling_handoff
inventory.title: Prepare Scheduling Handoff
inventory.description:
Prepare a governed scheduling handoff artifact for scheduler review.

Filters available options to those viable for scheduler review and records
a HANDOFF_PREPARED lifecycle event. Does not select, verify, authorize, or
book any option. Idempotent: repeated calls with the same case return the
same handoff_id without appending a duplicate event.

inventory.name: get_scheduling_handoff
inventory.title: Get Scheduling Handoff
inventory.description:
Retrieve a previously prepared scheduling handoff document by ID.

Read-only. Does not mutate lifecycle state. Returns an error payload if
the handoff_id is not found.

inventory.name: validate_option_selection
inventory.title: Validate Option Selection
inventory.description:
Validate that an option from a prepared handoff may be selected.

Read-only. Returns a structured validation result with valid=True/False,
the option details on success, and a reason string on failure.
Does not advance lifecycle state. Safe to call before record_option_selection.

option_id.description: Option ID to validate for selection.

inventory.name: record_option_selection
inventory.title: Record Option Selection
inventory.description:
Record a Scheduler's option selection and advance to OPTION_SELECTED.

Idempotent: repeated calls with the same idempotency_key and identical
selection data return the existing record without appending a duplicate event.
Conflicting reuse of idempotency_key (different option/case/actor) raises an
error and writes no state. Does not book, authorize, verify, or confirm.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied deduplication key. Same key + same selection = no-op. Same key + different selection = error.

inventory.name: prepare_veteran_confirmation_request
inventory.title: Prepare Veteran Confirmation Request
inventory.description:
Prepare a Veteran confirmation request.

Advances the case to PENDING_VETERAN_CONFIRMATION.

Creates a ConfirmationRequest artifact for the Veteran to review.
This is a mechanical system step — preparation is not Veteran consent.
Idempotent: repeated calls with the same inputs return the existing request
without appending a duplicate event. Does not book, authorize, or confirm.

option_id.description: Option ID of the verified/bookable option.

selection_id.description: Selection ID from record_option_selection. Scopes the confirmation request to this specific selection lifecycle path.

inventory.name: record_veteran_confirmation
inventory.title: Record Veteran Confirmation
inventory.description:
Record the Veteran's explicit confirmation response.

The Veteran's response must be explicit — preparation of a confirmation
request is not consent. Idempotent: repeated calls with the same
idempotency_key and identical response return the existing record without
appending a duplicate event. Conflicting reuse of idempotency_key (different
response or case) raises an error and writes no state.
Does not book, reserve, or create scheduler approval.

response.description: Veteran's explicit response. CONFIRMED advances to scheduler approval. DECLINED cancels the case. REQUESTED_CHANGE returns to human review.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied deduplication key. Same key + same response = no-op. Same key + different response = error.

inventory.name: validate_booking_preconditions
inventory.title: Validate Booking Preconditions
inventory.description:
Read-only check of all booking preconditions.

Validates lifecycle state, Veteran confirmation, Scheduler role,
HSRM authorization (Community Care), EPS slot availability (Community Care),
appointment intent, and idempotency. Does not write any state.
A passed result does not constitute a booking commitment.

slot_id.description: Specific slot identifier (EPS slot or VA slot).

appointment_intent.description: Explicit appointment intent. FOLLOW_UP fails closed for the EPS initial-consult path.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied deduplication key for this booking attempt.

inventory.name: record_lifecycle_event
inventory.title: Record Lifecycle Event
inventory.description:
Record a post-booking lifecycle outcome for a synthetic scheduling case.

Drives state transitions after a booking has been simulated:
- APPOINTMENT_COMPLETED → marks appointment as completed (terminal)
- VETERAN_NO_SHOW       → records no-show; staff follow-up available
- APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED → cancels post-booking (terminal)
- RESCHEDULE_REQUESTED  → marks for rescheduling
- FOLLOW_UP_INITIATED   → moves no-show case to human review
- NEW_SEARCH_INITIATED  → restarts search after rescheduling

Not all actor roles are permitted for all event types.
Idempotent: same idempotency_key with identical parameters returns
the existing event without writing new state.
Does not create, modify, or cancel real appointments.

actor_role.description: Role of the actor recording this outcome. Not all roles are permitted for all event types.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied deduplication key. Same key + same event = no-op. Same key + different event = error.

payload.description: Optional metadata (e.g. cancellation_reason, reschedule_notes). Stored on the audit event.
